import gzip
row=7594
col=639
count=0
entries=[]
with gzip.open('D2.matrix.mtx.gz','rt') as f:
    for lineno,line in enumerate(f,1):
        if line.startswith('%'):
            continue
        if lineno==3:
            # dims line
            print('dims',line.strip())
            continue
        parts=line.strip().split()
        if len(parts)<3:
            continue
        r=int(parts[0]); c=int(parts[1]); v=int(parts[2])
        if c<col:
            continue
        if c>col:
            print('passed col',c,'line',lineno)
            break
        if r==row:
            count += v
            entries.append((r,c,v,lineno))
    print('count',count,'entries',entries[:20], 'num',len(entries))
PY"

import gzip
# all SOX2 rows
rows=[]

    for i,line in enumerate(f,1):
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if parts[1]=='SOX2':
            rows.append((i,parts))
print('SOX2 rows',rows)
# all barcode matches
idxs=[]
with gzip.open('D2.barcodes.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    for i,line in enumerate(f,1):
        if line.rstrip('\\n')=='AAACCCAAGTCTTCGA-1':
            idxs.append(i)
print('barcode idxs',idxs)
# parse matrix for all matching rows and target col
target_rows=[r for r,_ in rows]
col=639
with gzip.open('D2.matrix.mtx.gz','rt') as f:
    for lineno,line in enumerate(f,1):
        if line.startswith('%') or lineno<=3:
            continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        r=int(parts[0]); c=int(parts[1]); v=int(parts[2])
        if c<col: continue
        if c>col: break
        if r in target_rows:
            print('hit',r,c,v,'line',lineno)
